mapper.select: WITH action_period AS ( SELECT strategy_option_id, MIN(start_date) AS planned_start_date, MAX(end_date) AS planned_end_date FROM strategy_action action WHERE action.is_deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM strategy_action incomplete WHERE incomplete.strategy_option_id = action.strategy_option_id AND incomplete.is_deleted = 0 AND (incomplete.start_date IS NULL OR incomplete.end_date IS NULL) ) GROUP BY strategy_option_id ), simulation_ranked AS ( SELECT simulation.strategy_option_id, simulation.expected_sales_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY simulation.strategy_option_id ORDER BY CASE simulation.input_source_type WHEN 'USER_SELECT' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, simulation.updated_at DESC, simulation.simulation_id DESC ) AS row_no FROM strategy_simulation simulation WHERE simulation.is_deleted = 0 ), latest_cost_ranked AS ( SELECT cost.sku_id, cost.unit_cost, period.strategy_option_id, period.planned_start_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY cost.sku_id, period.strategy_option_id ORDER BY cost.effective_from DESC, cost.updated_at DESC, cost.sku_cost_id DESC ) AS row_no FROM sku_cost cost JOIN strategy_case strategy_case ON strategy_case.sku_id = cost.sku_id AND strategy_case.is_deleted = 0 JOIN final_strategy_selection selection ON selection.strategy_case_id = strategy_case.strategy_case_id AND selection.is_deleted = 0 JOIN action_period period ON period.strategy_option_id = selection.strategy_option_id WHERE cost.is_deleted = 0 AND cost.effective_from <= period.planned_start_date AND (cost.effective_to IS NULL OR cost.effective_to >= period.planned_start_date) ) SELECT selection.final_selection_id, selection.created_by AS owner_user_id, period.planned_start_date, period.planned_end_date, simulation.expected_sales_qty AS goal_target_value, COUNT(snapshot.inventory_snapshot_id) AS snapshot_count, SUM(snapshot.on_total_qty) AS start_risk_stock_qty, SUM( CASE WHEN snapshot.expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND snapshot.expiry_date <= period.planned_end_date THEN GREATEST(snapshot.on_hand_qty - COALESCE(snapshot.forecast_qty, 0), 0) ELSE 0 END ) AS start_expected_disposal_qty, MAX(cost.unit_cost) AS start_unit_cost FROM final_strategy_selection selection JOIN strategy_case strategy_case ON strategy_case.strategy_case_id = selection.strategy_case_id AND strategy_case.is_deleted = 0 AND strategy_case.case_status IN ('READY_TO_EXECUTE', 'EXECUTING', 'EXECUTION_COMPLETED') JOIN action_period period ON period.strategy_option_id = selection.strategy_option_id LEFT JOIN simulation_ranked simulation ON simulation.strategy_option_id = selection.strategy_option_id AND simulation.row_no = 1 LEFT JOIN strategy_inventory_snapshot snapshot ON snapshot.strategy_case_id = selection.strategy_case_id AND snapshot.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN latest_cost_ranked cost ON cost.sku_id = strategy_case.sku_id AND cost.strategy_option_id = selection.strategy_option_id AND cost.planned_start_date = period.planned_start_date AND cost.row_no = 1 WHERE selection.is_deleted = 0 AND period.planned_start_date <= #{businessDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM strategy_execution_result existing WHERE existing.final_selection_id = selection.final_selection_id AND existing.is_deleted = 0 ) GROUP BY selection.final_selection_id, selection.created_by, period.planned_start_date, period.planned_end_date, simulation.expected_sales_qty ORDER BY selection.final_selection_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO strategy_execution_result ( final_selection_id, result_status, planned_start_date, planned_end_date, goal_metric_code, goal_target_value, start_risk_stock_qty, start_expected_disposal_qty, start_unit_cost, calculation_version, failure_reason, created_by, updated_by ) SELECT #{finalSelectionId}, CASE WHEN #{goalTargetValue} IS NOT NULL AND #{goalTargetValue} > 0 AND #{snapshotCount} > 0 AND #{startUnitCost} IS NOT NULL THEN 'RUNNING' ELSE 'PARTIAL' END, #{plannedStartDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{plannedEndDate,jdbcType=DATE}, 'SALES_QTY', #{goalTargetValue}, #{startRiskStockQty}, #{startExpectedDisposalQty}, #{startUnitCost}, 'SALES_ONLY_V1', CASE WHEN #{goalTargetValue} IS NULL OR #{goalTargetValue} <= 0 THEN '유효한 목표 판매량이 없습니다.' WHEN #{snapshotCount} = 0 THEN '전략 시작 재고 스냅샷이 없습니다.' WHEN #{startUnitCost} IS NULL THEN '전략 시작 기준 원가가 없습니다.' ELSE NULL END, #{ownerUserId}, #{ownerUserId} FROM dual WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM strategy_execution_result existing WHERE existing.final_selection_id = #{finalSelectionId} AND existing.is_deleted = 0 )
mapper.select: WITH pending_sync_ranked AS ( SELECT result.final_selection_id, result.planned_start_date, result.planned_end_date, result.goal_target_value, result.start_risk_stock_qty, result.start_expected_disposal_qty, result.start_unit_cost, selection.strategy_case_id, selection.strategy_option_id, selection.created_by AS owner_user_id, strategy_case.sku_id, sync_run.inventory_sync_run_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY result.final_selection_id ORDER BY sync_run.completed_at DESC, sync_run.inventory_sync_run_id DESC ) AS sync_row_no FROM strategy_execution_result result JOIN final_strategy_selection selection ON selection.final_selection_id = result.final_selection_id AND selection.is_deleted = 0 JOIN strategy_case strategy_case ON strategy_case.strategy_case_id = selection.strategy_case_id AND strategy_case.is_deleted = 0 JOIN inventory_sync_run sync_run ON sync_run.run_status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND TRUNC(sync_run.completed_at) > result.planned_end_date WHERE result.is_deleted = 0 AND result.result_status = 'RUNNING' AND result.planned_end_date < #{businessDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND result.goal_target_value IS NOT NULL AND result.start_risk_stock_qty IS NOT NULL AND result.start_expected_disposal_qty IS NOT NULL AND result.start_unit_cost IS NOT NULL ), pending AS ( SELECT * FROM pending_sync_ranked WHERE sync_row_no = 1 ), latest_risk_ranked AS ( SELECT assessment.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY assessment.inventory_balance_id ORDER BY assessment.updated_at DESC, assessment.risk_assessment_id DESC ) AS risk_row_no FROM risk_assessment assessment WHERE assessment.is_deleted = 0 ), scoped_inventory AS ( SELECT pending.final_selection_id, balance.inventory_balance_id, balance.on_hand_qty, balance.total_qty, lot.lot_status, COALESCE(lot.sale_stop_date, lot.expiry_date) AS effective_stop_date, risk.risk_grade, forecast.predicted_qty_d7, forecast.predicted_qty_d14, forecast.predicted_qty_d30, forecast.predicted_qty_d60, forecast.predicted_qty_d90, pending.planned_end_date FROM pending JOIN inventory_balance balance ON balance.sku_id = pending.sku_id AND balance.is_deleted = 0 AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM strategy_inventory_snapshot snapshot WHERE snapshot.strategy_case_id = pending.strategy_case_id AND snapshot.inventory_balance_id = balance.inventory_balance_id AND snapshot.is_deleted = 0 ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM strategy_action action WHERE action.strategy_option_id = pending.strategy_option_id AND action.is_deleted = 0 AND ( balance.warehouse_id IN (action.source_warehouse_id, action.destination_warehouse_id) OR balance.stock_sales_point_id IN (action.source_sales_point_id, action.target_sales_point_id) OR balance.allocated_sales_point_id IN (action.source_sales_point_id, action.target_sales_point_id) ) ) ) LEFT JOIN lot ON lot.lot_id = balance.lot_id AND lot.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN latest_risk_ranked risk ON risk.inventory_balance_id = balance.inventory_balance_id AND risk.risk_row_no = 1 LEFT JOIN demand_forecast forecast ON forecast.forecast_id = risk.forecast_id AND forecast.is_deleted = 0 ), inventory_metrics AS ( SELECT final_selection_id, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN risk_grade IN ('CRITICAL', 'WARNING') THEN total_qty ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS end_risk_stock_qty, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN effective_stop_date IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN effective_stop_date <= planned_end_date THEN on_hand_qty WHEN effective_stop_date <= planned_end_date + 7 THEN GREATEST(on_hand_qty - COALESCE(predicted_qty_d7, 0), 0) WHEN effective_stop_date <= planned_end_date + 14 THEN GREATEST(on_hand_qty - COALESCE(predicted_qty_d14, 0), 0) WHEN effective_stop_date <= planned_end_date + 30 THEN GREATEST(on_hand_qty - COALESCE(predicted_qty_d30, 0), 0) WHEN effective_stop_date <= planned_end_date + 60 THEN GREATEST(on_hand_qty - COALESCE(predicted_qty_d60, 0), 0) WHEN effective_stop_date <= planned_end_date + 90 THEN GREATEST(on_hand_qty - COALESCE(predicted_qty_d90, 0), 0) ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS end_expected_disposal_qty FROM scoped_inventory GROUP BY final_selection_id ), actual_sales AS ( SELECT pending.final_selection_id, GREATEST(COALESCE(SUM(sales.net_sales_qty), 0), 0) AS goal_actual_value FROM pending LEFT JOIN sales_daily sales ON sales.sku_id = pending.sku_id AND sales.is_deleted = 0 AND sales.sales_date BETWEEN pending.planned_start_date AND pending.planned_end_date AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM strategy_inventory_snapshot snapshot WHERE snapshot.strategy_case_id = pending.strategy_case_id AND snapshot.sales_point_id = sales.sales_point_id AND snapshot.is_deleted = 0 ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM strategy_action action WHERE action.strategy_option_id = pending.strategy_option_id AND action.is_deleted = 0 AND sales.sales_point_id IN (action.source_sales_point_id, action.target_sales_point_id) ) ) GROUP BY pending.final_selection_id ) SELECT pending.final_selection_id, pending.owner_user_id, pending.inventory_sync_run_id AS finalized_sync_run_id, pending.goal_target_value, COALESCE(actual_sales.goal_actual_value, 0) AS goal_actual_value, pending.start_risk_stock_qty, COALESCE(inventory_metrics.end_risk_stock_qty, 0) AS end_risk_stock_qty, pending.start_expected_disposal_qty, COALESCE(inventory_metrics.end_expected_disposal_qty, 0) AS end_expected_disposal_qty, pending.start_unit_cost FROM pending LEFT JOIN actual_sales ON actual_sales.final_selection_id = pending.final_selection_id LEFT JOIN inventory_metrics ON inventory_metrics.final_selection_id = pending.final_selection_id ORDER BY pending.final_selection_id
mapper.update: UPDATE strategy_execution_result SET result_status = 'COMPLETED', goal_actual_value = #{result.goalActualValue}, achievement_rate = #{achievementRate}, end_risk_stock_qty = #{result.endRiskStockQty}, end_expected_disposal_qty = #{result.endExpectedDisposalQty}, estimated_loss_savings_amount = #{estimatedLossSavingsAmount}, finalized_sync_run_id = #{result.finalizedSyncRunId}, failure_reason = NULL, completed_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{result.ownerUserId} WHERE final_selection_id = #{result.finalSelectionId} AND result_status = 'RUNNING' AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT selection.final_selection_id, strategy_case.strategy_case_id, selection.strategy_option_id, result.planned_end_date AS execution_end_date, result.achievement_rate, result.start_risk_stock_qty, result.end_risk_stock_qty, result.start_expected_disposal_qty, result.end_expected_disposal_qty, result.start_unit_cost, result.estimated_loss_savings_amount FROM strategy_execution_result result JOIN final_strategy_selection selection ON selection.final_selection_id = result.final_selection_id AND selection.is_deleted = 0 JOIN strategy_case ON strategy_case.strategy_case_id = selection.strategy_case_id AND strategy_case.is_deleted = 0 WHERE result.is_deleted = 0 AND result.result_status = 'COMPLETED' AND result.planned_end_date BETWEEN #{fromDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND #{toDate,jdbcType=DATE} ORDER BY result.planned_end_date, selection.final_selection_id
